title: Agent Lineage Card
description: Paste an agent decision receipt with a pp.lineage block and this page renders a human-legible lineage card: model identity and version tagged asserted or observed, the IOSCO agentic autonomy five, the intent to policy to action to outcome chain, the traceparent binding, and the hash bindings. When the artifact carries its preimage the embedded execution_hash is recomputed in your browser with the estate's canonical JCS serializer and compared, so a tampered lineage shows MISMATCH. Render only: the card displays exactly the states present in the input and invents nothing. Optional delegation_chain, human_checkpoints and revocable_by members render only when present and are labelled spec-pending; absent members render as not present. A #selftest=1 fragment runs the bundled golden fixture (MATCH), its one-byte tampered twin (MISMATCH) and a minimal fixture (absent optionals) end to end. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.
